_comment: ORW-184: the engine's seeded VOICE vocabulary, shared by both halves of one contract. `dials` must equal VOICE_DIALS in src/engine/voice.ts, and `fingerprintTemplates` must equal VOICE_LINE_TEMPLATES in src/domain/traitConsistency.ts (ORW-432: several sentence shapes, one picked per houseguest by voiceFingerprint()) (the roster card's `voice` clause the cast-authoring prompt hands the model as its brief). `humorWords` must equal HUMOR_WORDS in src/engine/voice.ts: how a humor dial reads in the {humor} slot when it is not the value itself (the dial "none" reads "no humor"). Guarded both ways: tests/unit/voiceVocabularyFixture.test.ts (the engine matches this file) and frontend/tests/test_orw184_voice_repair.py (the FE voice lint accepts every engine dial value, and the FE clause parser inverts the template). Change the engine vocabulary or template HERE too, which forces the FE side to be checked in the same PR.
